pass_guide.text: Hard hats on! Mind your heads. These passages were dug in the 1300s to carry lead water pipes into the city from springs outside the walls.
When a pipe leaked, you didn't dig up the street, you just walked down here and mended it. Very sensible. Very damp.
Some bits are so narrow you go sideways. In the war people sheltered down here from the bombs. And no, the ghosts don't charge extra.
